description: Mapping between the two gap vocabularies (P0 erratum, DECISIONS B7). run-log.gap.reason records the fine-grained operational cause; pursuit-plan.gap.kind is the coarser review-surface category shown at Gate 2. The engine writes the reason; the plan derives the kind via reason_to_kind.
notes: B24 (recorded decision, 2026-08-02): partner_only -> needs_sme and not_offered -> no_content are CONFIRMED. One action model: every kind surfaces as a flagged gap requiring a human disposition (answered | omit_approved | reframed | draft_flagged). Reframe is NEVER preselected — it is one option the human may pick, and it always carries mandatory_review when chosen. The reason values remain operational information only.
thin_content has no dedicated run-log reason; it is kb_empty at the operational layer with a thin-content marker in the plan.
